story_type: litter hoist off a cruise ship underway in whitecaps off the Alaska Peninsula, hoist camera
hook: A litter on a cable, swinging over the open sea off Alaska.
narration: This litter swung out over open water, hanging from a helicopter off Alaska.
The cruise ship Silver Shadow was south of Cold Bay, near the end of the Alaska Peninsula.
A passenger aboard needed a medevac, and an MH-60 crew flew out from Air Station Kodiak.
The rescue swimmer went out the door and rode the cable down to the ship.
The ship holds a steady course and speed. The pilot hovers beside it while the hoist operator talks the pilot over the deck.
On deck, the crew strapped the passenger into a rescue litter.
Then the litter lifted off the deck and out past the side of the ship.
It turned slowly in the rotor wash as the hoist operator reeled it in.
outcome: The Kodiak crew flew the passenger to Sand Point, where a commercial medical air service took over.
title: Litter hoisted off a cruise ship, Alaska
description:
An MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak hoisted a passenger from the cruise ship Silver Shadow south of Cold Bay, Alaska, on May 25, 2009, and flew the patient to Sand Point.
